Lfm3ForCausalLM.js: a WebGPU inference runtime for Liquid AI's LFM3 text models (GGUF).

Source: https://huggingface.co/spaces/webml-community/LFM3-1.7B-WebGPU-Pi (dist/runtime/Lfm3ForCausalLM.js)
License of the Space: Apache-2.0. The library includes Hugging Face tokenization and Jinja templating.

Default model: languel/LFM3-1.7B-pi-GGUF (LFM3-1.7B-pi-Q4_K_M.gguf), a fused derivative of
LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B and harness-hub/LFM3-1.7B-pi. Optional base model: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B-GGUF.
Weights are not bundled: they download on demand from Hugging Face into the browser's Cache API
and remain subject to the LFM Open License v1.0.

Used by p5comp's embedded Pi agent (sim/assistant/).
